proposal_support_conclusion.interpretation: Raw-benefit proposal recall is high, but safe-positive support inside the frozen top-3 is insufficient on the fit fold. This is a proposal/label/gate support failure before learned admission is considered.

main_algorithm_conclusion.near: Raw benefit signal remains, but it is not converted into a stable safe-admission policy. Balanced risk ordering is below random; Precision has only marginal conditional-risk improvements and still zero coverage.
main_algorithm_conclusion.contact: Precision broad harm AUC is retained, but high-opportunity conditional harm and continuous benefit ordering are not established. Balanced Contact is worse than v48.22.
main_algorithm_conclusion.ablation: The semantic prior/categorical correction provides most of the visible risk-AUC recovery. Raw-benefit listwise and frontier contrast do not produce complementary gains; D does not dominate B/C.

dataset_conclusion: The existing dataset is usable for this round but contributes substantial shift and sparse safe-positive support. The optimization avoids rebuilding data and instead changes target semantics, group sampling, and proposal support width.
macro_action_conclusion: Macro concentration is not the immediate RC=20 cause because the optimistic oracle audit ignores macro concentration. The macro set is semantically broad enough, but top-3/raw-benefit ranking often fails to expose safe variants. Widening to top-8 is a controlled support change; adding more macro names is not justified by the evidence.

shadow_closed_loop.root_cause: The diagnostic script called the strict deployment loader, which requires valid_for_deployment=true. After RC=20 the certificate is invalid by definition, so the shadow diagnostic was structurally unable to start.

engineering_defects: RC=20 dev-shadow invoked a deployment-only certificate loader and therefore failed before simulation.
Closed-loop runtime loaded only three thresholds and silently reverted to proposal_top_k=1, evidence_rerank_top_k=false, inconsistent with training/certificate top-3 reranking.
v48.23 categorical one-action training still retained the legacy Noisy-OR group opportunity objective at weight 1.25, creating contradictory gradients.
v48_24_changes: Top-k support audit curve at k=1,3,5,8 and the active k, split into fit/verify.
Safe-benefit opportunity labels and top-8 frozen proposal support.
Direct continuous safe-utility regression/listwise supervision on the exact deployed admission logit; harmful actions receive strictly negative targets.
Legacy Noisy-OR group opportunity loss disabled; one-action categorical objective retained.
Fit-only diagnostic selector for adaptation-dev shadow; deployment path remains certificate-strict.
Complete selector contract loaded at runtime: thresholds, rank margin, top-k, rerank and conditional ranking.
Four two-GPU ablation waves, one task per A30, four tasks per GPU.
guarantee: No code-only analysis can guarantee RC=0. v48.24 can pass only if top-8 safe-positive oracle support is feasible and the learned safe-utility policy reaches the preregistered gate. The new artifacts explicitly distinguish structural support failure (RC=30) from learned gate rejection (RC=20).
